title: Hum Shah Ke Azadaraan Shaydaye Ali Asghar
body:
Hum Shah Ke Azadaraan Shaydaye Ali Asghar
Shabbir Ke Ghamkahraan Shaydaye Aali Asghar
Matam Ye Hussaini Hai Ta Hashr Talak Hoga
Zehra Ke Haindildaaran Shaydaye Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek Raat Ke Dulha Ki Kubra Bani Thi Dulhan
Marzi Thi Ye Khudaraan Shaydaye Aali Asghar
Nehare Furaat Par Jab Shanounko Kataya Tha
Wo Fouje Alamdaaran Shaydaye Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Seene Pe Sina Khake Akbar Ne Kaha Baba
Laila Ka Tha Dulhara Shaydaye Ali Asghar
Nanha S Alai Asghar Haathoun Pa Shahedein Ke
Kehte Hain Sheerkhwran Shaydaye Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Sine Pa Sone Wali Shahzadi Sakina Wo
Zainab Ki Dilfgaran Shaydaye Ali Asghar
Dikhre Hue The Laashe Har Simt Bahathar Ke
Siadanioun Ke Shouran Shaydaye Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Bimar-e-karbala Pe Kaisi Wo Qayamat Thi
Koi Na Madadgaran Shaydaye Ali Asghar
Allah Zulm Kaisa Dekha Na Suna Hoga
Zainab Thi Bedayaran Shaydaye Ali Asghar
<<DIVIDER>>
Islam Kiya Zinda Sar Ko Katake Apne
Ab Hogaye Charagan Shaydaye Ali Asghar
Likha N Agaya Razvi Ye Haal Karbala Ka
Akbar Hai Nouha Khwakaran Shaydaye Ali Asghar
